question: Among drivers who completed more than 50 laps in any Canadian Grand Prix between 2000 and 2010, find the one with the most race wins during that same period (2000–2010). Return their full name and total number of wins.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN races AS ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
      AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
      AND r.XCL_083 > 50
),
win_counts AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN races AS ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
      AND r.XCL_079 = 1
      AND r.XCL_075 IN (SELECT driver_id FROM qualifying_drivers)
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, w.total_wins
FROM win_counts AS w
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON w.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY w.total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1

    SELECT DISTINCT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
      AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
      AND r.XCL_083 > 50
),

    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM results r

    WHERE ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010

    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
)

    SELECT r.XCL_065 AS race_id, s.XCL_091 AS year
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    JOIN seasons s ON r.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Canada'
      AND s.XCL_091 BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
),
qualified_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT res.XCL_075 AS driver_id
    FROM results res
    JOIN canadian_gp cg ON res.XCL_074 = cg.race_id
    WHERE res.XCL_083 > 50
),
driver_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        d.XCL_034 AS driver_id,
        d.XCL_037 || ' ' || d.XCL_038 AS full_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    JOIN canadian_gp cg ON res.XCL_074 = cg.race_id
    WHERE d.XCL_034 IN (SELECT driver_id FROM qualified_drivers)
      AND res.XCL_079 = 1
    GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_037, d.XCL_038
)
SELECT 
    full_name,
    total_wins
FROM driver_wins
ORDER BY total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1
